sections.title: Divisibility rules
facts: $2$, $4$, $8$: the last one, two or three digits. $5$: last digit $0$ or $5$.
$3$ and $9$: the digit sum. $11$: the alternating sum of the digits.
Combine tests whose numbers share no factor: $12 = 3 \times 4$, $18 = 2 \times 9$.

sections.title: Primes & factorization
facts: $1$ is not prime; $2$ is the only even prime.
Every number above $1$ is a product of primes in exactly one way.
To test $n$, try primes up to $\sqrt{n}$. Look-alikes: $91 = 7 \cdot 13$, $143 = 11 \cdot 13$, $221 = 13 \cdot 17$.

sections.title: GCD & LCM
facts: GCD: each shared prime to the smaller power. LCM: every prime to the larger power.
"Together again" is an LCM; "largest equal pieces" is a GCD.

sections.title: Counting divisors
facts: Sum of divisors: $(1 + p + \cdots + p^a)(1 + q + \cdots + q^b)$.
Only perfect squares have an odd number of divisors.

sections.title: Factorials & trailing zeros
facts: From $5!$ on, every factorial ends in $0$.
